changelog.title: Search Suggestions Quick Actions
changelog.description: Inline 3-dot menu and Like button directly on typeahead search suggestions, along with swipe-to-queue gesture.

changelog.title: Library Album & Playlist Likes
changelog.description: Liking albums or playlists from Home, Search, or headers now saves them directly into your Library collection instead of adding them as single songs in Liked Songs.

changelog.title: Liked Songs Auto-Cleanup
changelog.description: Automatically filters out miscategorized album and playlist entries from Liked Songs with seamless navigation fallback.

changelog.title: 1-Tap Header Like Action
changelog.description: Added dedicated Like/Save buttons directly inside Album and Playlist headers for instant library saving.

changelog.title: Offline Playback & SAF Resolution
changelog.description: Fixed local file URI resolution under Storage Access Framework (SAF) so downloaded songs play reliably offline.

changelog.title: Playback Stream Resilience
changelog.description: Resolved stream switching race conditions and audio buffer resets when moving between offline and online media.

changelog.title: Dynamic Version Information
changelog.description: About Us and Settings screens dynamically display the active version (v3.0.1).

changelog.title: Performance & Crash Prevention
changelog.description: Zero ANRs, streamlined Room database flows, and verified stability across Android 7.0 through Android 16.

additionalNotes: To get the best from Obsidian, please keep your device up to date and regularly check for software updates.
